name: Human System
tagline: Your whole health as one longitudinal picture.
description: Biomarkers, interventions and the alerts that fall out of the two together, arrayed around a single anatomical figure. Self-hosted and single-user. Your records stay on your server; the only thing that leaves is a document you choose to send to Anthropic for extraction, using your own API key.
postInstall: Open it and create your account on the first-run screen. Then bring your history in: the Import screen takes a bulk-import file, whose format the app itself serves at /.well-known/hs-import-schema.json, and the Documents screen takes lab reports.
